html:
Monkey Island Nha Trang, also known as Hon Lao Island, is a must-visit destination for travelers who love nature, wildlife, and unique island experiences. Famous for its fresh air, unspoiled scenery, and thousands of playful monkeys, the island offers an unforgettable day trip just outside Nha Trang city.

This comprehensive guide provides everything you need to know for a self-guided trip to Monkey Island in 2026, including transportation tips, history, the best time to visit, exciting activities, essential travel tips, nearby attractions, and estimated costs.

Where Is Monkey Island Nha Trang And How To Get There?

Monkey Island, officially called Hon Lao Island, is located in Ninh Phu Commune, Ninh Hoa Town, Khanh Hoa Province. It lies about 18 kilometers north of Nha Trang city, within the picturesque Nha Phu Bay. Thanks to its natural beauty and unique ecosystem, Monkey Island is one of the most popular eco-tourism destinations in the region.

To reach Monkey Island, travelers must first get to Long Phu Tourist Wharf (also known as Da Chong Port), located in Vinh Luong Commune, around 15 kilometers from Nha Trang city center. From there, boats or speedboats take visitors to the island.

Transportation From Nha Trang City To Long Phu Wharf

  • Motorbike: A flexible and budget-friendly option for independent travelers. Motorbike rental costs around 100,000–150,000 VND per day. Follow Pham Van Dong Street northward, then turn onto National Highway 1A and follow signs to Long Phu Wharf.

  • Taxi Or Grab: Ideal for families or groups seeking comfort and convenience. One-way fares range from 200,000–300,000 VND.

  • Public Bus: Bus route No. 01 (Nha Trang – Ninh Hoa) passes by Long Phu Wharf and is the most economical option.

From Long Phu Wharf To Monkey Island

  • Tourist Boat: Travel time is approximately 20–30 minutes, with scheduled departures throughout the day.

  • Speedboat: Faster, taking only 10–15 minutes, suitable for groups who want to save time.

Boat tickets usually include both round-trip transportation and entrance fees to Monkey Island.

History And Development Of Monkey Island

Originally, Monkey Island was not a natural habitat for monkeys. In around 1975, Soviet scientists brought the first monkeys to Hon Lao for medical and biological research. Thanks to the island’s ideal natural conditions, abundant food sources, and clean environment, the monkeys thrived and multiplied rapidly.

Today, Monkey Island is home to more than 1,500 monkeys, mainly red-faced macaques and gray monkeys. They live freely in a semi-wild environment, creating a unique ecosystem that is both fascinating and educational. The island now serves not only as a tourist attraction but also as an important center for wildlife conservation and research.

Best Time To Visit Monkey Island Nha Trang

Monkey Island can be visited year-round due to Nha Trang’s mild climate. However, the best time to go is from April to September, when the weather is sunny, dry, and the sea is calm—perfect for outdoor activities and island exploration.

Travelers should avoid the rainy and stormy season from October to December, as boat transportation may be affected. For a quieter experience, visiting on weekdays rather than weekends or public holidays is recommended.

Top Experiences On Monkey Island Nha Trang

Monkey Island offers much more than just observing monkeys. It is a lively entertainment and eco-tourism destination suitable for all ages.

1. Interact With Thousands Of Playful Monkeys

This is the highlight of any visit. With over 1,500 monkeys roaming freely, visitors can easily encounter them throughout the island. You can purchase food such as corn, peanuts, or fruit on the island to feed the monkeys and take memorable photos. However, always follow safety guidelines and avoid teasing or feeding inappropriate food.

2. Enjoy Entertaining Monkey Shows

Visitors can also watch professionally trained monkey performances. These shows feature monkeys riding bicycles, balancing, and performing amusing tricks that delight both children and adults alike.

3. Explore Suoi Hoa Lan Ecotourism Area

Located next to Monkey Island, Suoi Hoa Lan is a beautiful nature reserve featuring a natural stream, colorful orchid gardens, and a mini zoo with animals such as bears, ostriches, and peacocks. The beach here is also ideal for swimming and relaxation.

4. Try Exciting Water Sports

Monkey Island offers various water activities, including parasailing, jet skiing, kayaking, and snorkeling. These activities are especially enjoyable on sunny days and add adventure to your island experience.

5. Discover Local Cuisine

After exploring the island, enjoy fresh seafood at local restaurants. Dishes are prepared from freshly caught seafood from Nha Phu Bay and can be grilled, steamed, or cooked in hotpot style. Snacks and refreshing drinks are also available.

Important Travel Tips When Visiting Monkey Island

  • Wear comfortable clothing and bring sun protection such as hats, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

  • Keep a safe distance from monkeys and avoid sudden movements or loud noises.

  • Secure personal belongings, as monkeys are curious and may grab items.

  • Follow all instructions from island staff to ensure safety and environmental protection.

  • Book tickets or tours in advance during peak seasons.

  • Bring cash, as some small vendors may not accept card payments.

Nearby Attractions Around Monkey Island

Visitors can easily combine Monkey Island with other attractions in Nha Phu Bay, such as:

  • Hon Thi Ecotourism Area: Featuring ostrich farms, deer gardens, and traditional folk games.

  • An Binh Beach: A quiet, unspoiled beach ideal for relaxation.

  • Ninh Thuy Fishing Village: Learn about local fishermen’s daily lives and enjoy affordable fresh seafood.

  • Ba Ho Waterfalls: A scenic trekking destination with three natural waterfalls, perfect for nature lovers.

Estimated Cost For A Self-Guided Monkey Island Trip

  • Entrance Ticket And Boat/Speedboat (Round Trip): 180,000–250,000 VND per person

  • Transportation To Long Phu Wharf:

    • Motorbike fuel: 30,000–50,000 VND

    • Taxi/Grab: 200,000–300,000 VND one way

  • Meals: 150,000–300,000 VND per person

  • Optional Activities: 200,000–500,000 VND per activity

  • Souvenirs: Depending on personal preference

Overall, a one-day trip to Monkey Island typically costs 500,000–1,000,000 VND per person, excluding accommodation and transportation to Nha Trang.

Photography Tips At Monkey Island

  • Capture natural moments with monkeys rather than forcing poses.

  • Use early morning or late afternoon light for warmer, more vibrant photos.

  • Experiment with different angles for creative shots.

  • Take advantage of the island’s beaches, greenery, and orchid gardens as scenic backdrops.

Monkey Island Nha Trang is truly a destination not to be missed when visiting this beautiful coastal city. With its lively wildlife, diverse activities, and stunning natural scenery, it promises an unforgettable experience. Hopefully, this detailed guide has provided everything you need to plan a memorable self-guided trip to Monkey Island in 2026.
